explication: StreaMonitor monitors configured live-stream accounts, checks their status through site-specific adapters, records available streams, and exposes lifecycle controls and recording/status views through local console, ZeroMQ, and web interfaces. The README documents site coverage, selectable resolutions, and recording management. Some central runtime files (notably Bot and downloader implementations) were not sampled, so their internal call wiring is represented only where supported by the tree or excerpts.
